item.title: Digitalisation of and by projects: A sociotechnical perspective on the consequences for project work
item.content:encoded:
This special issue explores the digitalisation of and by projects from a sociotechnical perspective, examining the consequences for project work and how digital technologies reshape project management practices, organizational structures, and professional roles.
